$comment: Every knob OS Code has, with its default. An EMPTY config is valid: defaults give you a working single-model setup once osc init picks your orchestrator. Copy this file to os-code.config.json (per project) or ~/.os-code/config.json (global) and keep only what you change.

ollama.$comment: Also speaks LM Studio (http://localhost:1234), llama.cpp server, and vLLM. apiKeyEnv names an env var if the server wants a key.

anthropic.$comment: Added automatically by osc login. auth 'subscription' is an experimental stub; 'api-key' is the real path.

imageGen.$comment: Optional diffusion server for the image-generation specialist. Kinds: a1111, openai-images, comfyui (comfyui pending a workflow file).

stack.$comment: The orchestrator is the one required role and can point at ollama OR anthropic. Every specialist is optional; missing ones degrade quietly to the orchestrator.

routing.$comment: mode 'orchestrator-only' never delegates. Escalation to cloud requires enabled:true AND a connected account AND your per-task approval.

resourceBudget.$comment: auto detects VRAM and picks single/dual/fleet. vramOverrideGB forces a number on headless boxes.

search.$comment: duckduckgo needs no key. searxng is the fully private, self-hosted path.

egress.$comment: Governs every outbound request the agent makes. Local endpoints are always allowed. A non-empty allowlist restricts the web to those hosts.

permissions.$comment: Rules run top down, first match wins. trustedRepos lists absolute paths where writes flow without asking.

daemon.$comment: bind 'tailscale' serves your tailnet interface. 0.0.0.0 is refused, always.
